title: From Kylie to Barnesy, Gudinski put Australian music on the map
text: March 2, 2021 - It’s hard to comprehend in these days when the international success of, say, Sia and Tame Impala is hardly noteworthy, but when Gudinski first started out as an 18-year-old promoter in 1970, Australia was still something of a musical backwater. True, the Redcliffe-raised Bee Gees had repatriated to the UK and enjoyed success on both sides of the Atlantic, and the Easybeats, also foreign-born, had notched up a hit in Britain with Friday On My Mind. But Australian music itself was an added extra for most fans.
